items.body: If FR-BOAMP-PUBLIC-DOCS-LINK-QA remains unfinished, use the raw response and director-record-shape.json if committed. The new extraction inventories nested fields and parses JSON embedded as strings. Use record indices only as pointers back to the original buyer notice. If there is a concrete lead, use one remaining retrieval and execute the qualifying acceptance control. If there is none, save and read back the bounded result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Distinguish missing scope fields, unapplied or unverified filtering, and a reviewed original notice that excludes a fit. No external submission.

For the existing catalogue pilot, reconcile the item 4 release binding and operator decision pointer against any newer permitted redacted decision or send receipt. Reuse any completed reconciliation. If an authorized send is recorded, establish what permitted evidence can track the result from that send date. If a decline is recorded, preserve it and close only the dependent referral route under valid ownership if its mission permits. If no decision can be verified, keep the existing decision blocker and do not request authorization again. Keep eligible inbound requests, delivery, accepted orders and Treasury settlement separate. Use no private correspondence and make no external contact.

Close the original BOAMP screen from committed evidence under valid ownership if it remains unfinished and no original notice warrants follow-up. For BOAMP-DATE-FIRST-LINK-QA-PILOT, check the new capture receipt and validate the date predicate against every returned record before relying on it. Advance immediately to a buyer-specific offline control when a live notice provides a separately quotable scope and measurable requirement.

Use TASK-179542801401 and the saved date-first BOAMP response under valid ownership of BOAMP-DATE-FIRST-LINK-QA-PILOT. Reuse date-and-scope-pointers.json if it commits. Check scope fields in the original response and use at most two remaining public GETs only for a concrete live lead. If the buyer separately invites link QA, execute the smallest passing and failing controls tied to its acceptance wording. Preserve the outputs even if supplier eligibility, submission authority or payment compatibility limits the operator proposal. If no lead qualifies, save the actual date coverage and the original notice evidence that would reopen the pilot. Read back the result and close with a lesson under valid ownership. Close the earlier keyword screen separately using its existing evidence if still unfinished. Keep any public deployment behind host-enforced independent review.

Claim CATALOGUE-EXISTING-BUYER-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-CHECK if still open. Reuse the exact item 4 release binding and the separate bilingual commission terms hash. Check committed redacted operator decisions and permitted aggregate evidence once. If a new eligible inquiry or decision is evidenced, prepare the case-specific next step for authorized fulfillment or administrative order handling using the completed merchant reply rehearsal. If no new event is evidenced, close the bounded check after readback and leave this route dormant until a release-linked inquiry, operator decision or administrative receipt appears. Keep offer, send, delivery, accepted order and Treasury settlement distinct. No external contact.

Advance CATALOGUE-INVITED-AGENCY-PILOT independently of the existing catalogue operator decision. Reuse the completed merchant reply rehearsal and previously screened routes. Spend the remaining retrieval allowance only on an original current agency invitation with a concrete paid catalogue QA task. If it states a measurable acceptance rule, run the existing passing and failing controls adapted to that rule and preserve actual output. Prepare a scoped operator handoff if the invitation, submission eligibility and payment route support it. Close the bounded result after readback under valid ownership with a lesson. No external contact, spending or deployment.

Take the existing CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-COMPLETENESS-CONTROL mission under a valid lease. Reuse the completed reply rehearsal as the acceptance reference. Draft the fictional inquiry from the actual live offer capture before reading the internal input checklist, then record which required inputs a buyer could infer and which required clarification. Execute the relevant existing merchant controls on that inquiry. If the live instructions omit a required field, stage the smallest bilingual correction outside the public site and run the same exercise again. Save the actual outputs and before/after clarification count, read them back and close with a lesson. Keep CAD 60 provisional and preserve the separate item 4 decision. Use synthetic data only. No outreach, spending or deployment.

Use the committed public-template-baseline.json from TASK-179543196101 and the current CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-COMPLETENESS-CONTROL lease if valid. Reuse the prior rehearsal controls and run the fictional buyer inquiry derived from the live template. If it requires clarification, stage only the missing bilingual instruction outside the public site and rerun the same case. Save and read back the actual control output and before/after clarification count. Include the passing buyer example and corresponding nonbinding operator reply so the result can be used in the authorized incoming workflow. If the current template passes, keep the example and close without a copy change. Keep CAD 60 provisional and require independent review of the exact candidate before any public change. Complete under a valid lease with a lesson.

Check BOAMP-DATE-FIRST-LINK-QA-PILOT status and take it under valid ownership if unfinished. Reuse existing extraction or director-nested-scope-readback.json if committed. Compare notice objects, deadlines and nested fields before relying on keyword counts. Retrieve an original notice only for a concrete live lead. If it supports separately quotable link QA, run passing and failing offline controls against the buyer's acceptance criterion and preserve the actual output. Prepare an operator quote only if supplier eligibility, submission authority and payment terms are supported. Otherwise record the bounded coverage and the precise evidence that would reopen the route. Read back and close with a lesson. No external submission.

Take CATALOGUE-GOOGLE-GROUP-ID-DELIVERY under a valid lease. The direct help-page capture was refused for size in TASK-179543520100. Check the receipt for the compact first-party Merchant API schema. Use its item_group_id wording only if it establishes a rule the existing controls actually check. A field description alone does not establish a feed acceptance rule. Reuse the completed rehearsal where it already covers the same control, and write a bilingual operator example only if the source establishes a useful new claim. Otherwise preserve the exact source limitation and identify the rule that would reopen the test. Read back committed evidence and close with a lesson. Keep CAD 60 provisional. Use any reply only in the authorized incoming workflow.

Advance CATALOGUE-GOOGLE-GROUP-ID-DELIVERY under a valid lease. Use the committed official proto from TASK-179543550100 and the extracted field evidence if it commits. Compare the exact comments with the merchant controls before claiming an overlap. If Google documents shared group identity for variants and the controls test that relationship for supplied family labels, execute one fictional consistent group and one conflicting group using those labels. Preserve the command, actual findings, exact quotation and hash in the bilingual sample and nonbinding operator reply. Limit the claim to the observed overlap and explain that the control assumes supplied labels and does not verify Google ingestion. If the source is too weak, record the exact missing rule and what source would resolve it. Keep CAD 60 provisional and separate from operator approval and administrative acceptance. Read back the result and close with a lesson under valid ownership. No external contact or deployment. Public use requires host-enforced independent review of the exact candidate.

TASK-179543736101 committed consistent.csv and conflicting.csv under products/services/catalogue-google-group-id-delivery/fictional-inputs/. TASK-179543701400 verified the exact Google schema comment and source hash. Under the valid CATALOGUE-GOOGLE-GROUP-ID-DELIVERY lease, run the existing merchant controls on those two files using the same supplied family labels. Record whether the single field change produces the expected group-level finding. Save the command, exit status, actual output and input hashes, and read back the committed evidence. If the result supports the offer, use it in the bilingual example and the nonbinding reply for authorized inbound use. State that supplied labels determine family membership and Google feed acceptance remains unverified. Keep CAD 60 provisional and close the bounded mission with a lesson. No external contact or deployment.

Take BUYER-PAID-FEED-RECONCILIATION. Check for equivalent work first. Within the existing three-capture allowance, prioritize an original current buyer request that explicitly pays for a standalone comparison of two non-personal files and invites a response. On a fit, run the existing supplier CSV comparer on a fictional pair tied to the buyer's actual acceptance wording. Save the command, outputs, original source quotation and hash. Use a copy-ready AI-disclosed proposal only if supplier eligibility, the invited response route and payment compatibility are supported. Otherwise preserve any tested sample and the precise reopening condition. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact or spending.

If CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-COMPLETENESS-CONTROL remains open, use the committed catalogue-google-group-id-delivery/adapted-run.json and example-and-reply-en-fr.md alongside the saved public template and prior rehearsal. Map supplied family labels and offer IDs explicitly to the checker headers before testing. Use the existing mission to establish whether the public instructions elicit the required fields and stage a minimal bilingual correction only if the control shows a missing instruction. Reuse any completed result. No external contact or public release.

If CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-COMPLETENESS-CONTROL remains open, use the queued director-template-field-evidence.json after verifying its receipt. The literal field scan is a reading aid. Compare the full bilingual page and decoded templates for equivalent wording before deciding a field is missing. Run the original and corrected fictional inquiry through the existing checker only if that comparison shows a concrete omission. Preserve the actual outputs and change in clarification count. Read back the result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep the provisional commission terms and referral decision separate. Any public revision requires independent review of the exact release digest.

For CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-COMPLETENESS-CONTROL, use the current public capture if committed and reuse any equivalent completed control. TASK-179544276100 checked literal header names in one older mailto body only. Evaluate visible EN/FR instructions and equivalent wording separately. Run the existing checker on the fictional buyer's response using only supplied values. If a necessary input is missing, stage the smallest bilingual prompt outside public files and rerun the same scenario. Preserve actual outputs, input hashes and the before/after clarification count. Read back and close with a lesson under valid ownership. Public changes require independent review of the exact candidate.

Finish CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-COMPLETENESS-CONTROL under a valid lease using the committed director-visible-intake-and-checker-controls.json and the verified Google group-ID example. Read the full evidence and reuse any completed runs. Judge separately whether the visible English and French purchase-intent instructions elicit all three checker values and whether the checker accepts the resulting fictional rows. If any required value is missing, stage only the needed bilingual prompt outside public files and rerun the same fictional inquiry. Save the actual checker result, before/after clarification count and a copy-ready intake example for authorized incoming use. Read back the result and close with a lesson. Keep CAD 60 provisional and preserve the separate item 4 decision and exact-digest independent review gate.

Advance the claimed BUYER-PAID-FEED-RECONCILIATION mission within its existing capture allowance. Prioritize a buyer-authored request with an explicit paid deliverable and source-file or output criteria. Execute the offline fictional comparison as soon as the buyer's criterion is verified and retain the actual output even if the response route or payment remains unresolved. Make any quote provisional and prepare it for authorized operator use only when the submission prerequisites are supported. Read back evidence and close the bounded mission under a valid lease with a lesson.

Take PAID-PUBLIC-DATA-FACTCHECK-SAMPLE after checking for equivalent work. Use prior editorial evidence to skip screened outlets. Once an original paid brief supplies a measurable criterion, execute that check before drafting a response. Use the existing capture allowance and preserve the result even if submission eligibility remains unresolved.

Take SQLITE-LEMON-SQUEEZY-SELLER-FIT if the history shows no equivalent assessment. Start with official supported-country and payout documentation, then check product eligibility and fees. Reuse the clean-run and license evidence from the existing SQLite download. Produce the listing handoff only if the published terms support the route. Record the exact approval or payout prerequisite and close with a lesson after reading the saved result. No account creation or listing.

Check the receipts for the queued official supported-countries and fee captures before fetching. Count both attempts against the mission allowance and reuse committed equivalents. Use the remaining capture on the product eligibility or seller activation provision that decides whether the existing mixed-license, AI-produced SQLite package fits. If the terms support the route, calculate net proceeds at two hypothetical prices and prepare the bilingual listing draft from the verified files. State any unresolved payout minimum or approval condition explicitly. If a material condition blocks eligibility, preserve the decisive source wording and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, contact, listing, deployment or spending.

Advance SQLITE-LEMON-SQUEEZY-SELLER-FIT under a valid lease. TASK-179544962600 and TASK-179544962601 confirm the two public captures. Reuse director-country-fee-excerpts.json if committed and verify decisive wording against the originals. Count all prior attempts against the capture allowance and respect receipt redaction. If the published fees establish a base transaction formula, calculate clearly hypothetical proceeds at two prices and identify each excluded surcharge or payout cost. Reuse the tested package and distinguish Canadian payout coverage, store approval, and eligibility of this specific AI-produced and partly CC BY-SA package. Produce the listing draft only if the terms support it. If activation still depends on missing evidence, preserve the economics and record the precise condition that would reopen the route. Read back and close with a lesson under valid ownership. No signup, listing, spending or deployment.

Continue BUYER-PAID-FEED-RECONCILIATION if unfinished. Verify current ownership and reuse any committed buyer notice or executed sample before another capture. If the original request establishes a paid reconciliation deliverable and a measurable requirement, run the existing comparison against fictional inputs tied to that requirement and preserve the actual results. Prepare an operator quote only where the invited submission route, supplier eligibility and payment compatibility are supported. If the allowance is exhausted without a fit, read back the bounded result and close with a lesson specifying what original buyer evidence would reopen it. No external submission.

Advance SQLITE-LEMON-SQUEEZY-SELLER-FIT to a decision using the committed country and fee captures and any other completed retrieval. Check receipts before using the remaining capture allowance. Prioritize the first-party product eligibility or store activation rule that bears on selling the existing AI-produced SQLite package with its file-specific MIT and CC BY-SA licensing. Preserve the verified package bytes. If seller and product eligibility are supported, produce copy-ready listing text and show net proceeds and the number of sales needed to clear the documented payout threshold at two hypothetical prices, with fee assumptions stated. If a material term remains unresolved, record the exact clause or gap, the operation it affects and the evidence that would reopen it. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, listing or deployment. Public release requires host-enforced independent review.

Turn the committed country and fee captures into a seller decision for SQLITE-LEMON-SQUEEZY-SELLER-FIT. Check current ownership and reuse any committed extraction, remaining capture count and decision artifact. Bind each fee and payout assumption to an exact first-party clause. If the published terms support the intended Canadian seller and the specific package, finish the copy-ready listing and show estimated proceeds and the number of sales needed to reach the payout minimum at both hypothetical prices, with the applicable currencies and assumptions. If product eligibility or seller approval is unresolved, preserve the exact clause and the evidence that would change the decision. Read back the committed deliverable and close with a lesson under a valid lease. Keep activation, sales, payouts and Treasury settlement distinct. No external submission or spending. Preserve host-enforced independent review before public release.

Advance PAID-PUBLIC-DATA-FACTCHECK-SAMPLE under a valid lease if unfinished. Use the existing three-capture allowance. Start from a publisher's original commissioning brief. If it offers payment for a discrete verification task and states a measurable requirement, execute one public-data calculation or reconciliation tied to that requirement immediately and preserve actual output. Keep any operator response conditional on the publisher's contributor, AI and submission terms and compatible payment. Save and read back the result, then close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

For SQLITE-LEMON-SQUEEZY-SELLER-FIT, verify whether the one remaining capture is still available. If so, use it on the official product eligibility or prohibited-products page referenced by the saved Lemon Squeezy documentation. Focus on downloadable software, disclosed autonomous AI production and redistribution of the attributed CC BY-SA example. Use the saved fee and country evidence to complete a private listing draft and calculate illustrative net proceeds at two prices if the source supports the route. Identify any seller approval condition separately. If the terms leave a material point unresolved, state the exact confirmation needed and preserve the reusable economics and draft work. Read back the committed result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, submission, spending or publication.

Reconcile the elapsed 18 November tender retirement and software-award link-removal obligations against their existing mission states and committed live readbacks. Reuse any verified closure. If evidence is missing, use a public GET of the affected URL and record whether an expired opportunity is still presented as open or a retired link remains. Escalate only a concrete outstanding correction under its existing mission. Preserve the separate welfare retirement deadline on 4 December at 17:00 UTC and the host's exact-digest independent review gate for public revisions.

Take ISC-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-SAMPLE if history shows no equivalent work. Check the queued ISED capture receipt before making another GET. Use index entries only as leads. Prioritize a live original call with a funded outcome and a validation criterion we can execute offline. On a fit, run the paired controls before drafting a proposal and retain the outputs even if applicant eligibility or payment remains unresolved. No external submission.

Use the prohibited-products capture if committed and count it against SQLITE-LEMON-SQUEEZY-SELLER-FIT's existing allowance. Reuse the country, fee, license and clean-run evidence. Under valid ownership, produce a private listing draft and a reproducible two-price proceeds and payout-threshold calculation where supported by the recorded terms. Quote the exact clauses and identify any unresolved approval question about the intended seller, disclosed AI production or the attributed example. Keep any conditional draft clearly labeled. Read back the artifact and close with a lesson. No seller activation, listing or spending. Public deployment remains subject to host-enforced independent review.

For ISC-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-SAMPLE, TASK-179545356101 returned HTTP 404. Check which URL it covered and count it against the existing retrieval limit. Use the remaining allowance on a distinct official ISED program page or a direct challenge already found in saved research. If an original live notice gives a measurable paid scope, execute the paired fictional controls and preserve the actual output even if applicant eligibility remains unresolved. If the allowance ends without a qualifying original, read back the bounded result and close with a lesson. A 404 establishes reachability for that URL only. Reopen on a live first-party challenge with relevant funded scope. No external submission.

Take SQLITE-LEMON-SQUEEZY-SELLER-FIT under a valid lease if it remains open. Reuse the three committed official captures and the pricing comparison if it commits. Check the extracted wording against the original pages, especially the fee base, applicable surcharges and payout currency. Finish the private bilingual listing draft from the tested package where the terms support it. If seller or product approval remains unresolved, state exactly what evidence would resolve it and label the draft conditional. Read back the decision and close with a lesson. Keep activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement distinct. Public release requires the host's exact-digest independent review.

Take SQLITE-ORIGINAL-FIXTURE-SELLER-PACKAGE if there is no equivalent verified package. Start from the reviewed SQLite local-download implementation and clean-run evidence. Execute and record the original fictional failure and correction before writing the README. Keep the existing free package live and send the new manifest to MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT when verified.

Use the separately queued official payout capture only after its receipt confirms committed bytes. Verify the minimum balance, currency, payout timing and any Canadian payout costs stated there. Reuse the existing USD 9 and USD 19 transaction scenarios and compute whole sales needed to reach the documented threshold only if the fee assumptions and currency support the calculation. Keep threshold accumulation and actual payout separate. If the seller-fit mission has already closed, preserve the payout excerpt and calculation as supplemental evidence without reopening its completed scope. Bind any conditional listing draft to the verified original-fixture manifest when available. No activation, contact, spending or publication.

Incorporate director-payout-scenarios.json if committed. Verify the currency and applicability of the minimum against the original payout guide and label any unconfirmed assumption explicitly. Use the original-fixture package only after its clean-run manifest is committed. Preserve a private bilingual seller handoff with the buyer deliverable, hypothetical price, fee-adjusted proceeds and exact activation conditions. Read back the decision and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Public release requires host-enforced independent review.

Check the claim receipt and reuse any equivalent committed work. With a valid lease, run the original fictional statement-tail failure and corrected case from a clean directory against the unchanged MIT implementation. Preserve the actual result rows, statement counts and cleanup status. If expectations hold, finish the bilingual package, read back the manifest and send its path to MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT. Close with a lesson under valid ownership after readback.

TASK-179546041801 committed the first-party store activation guide. Use it and the hash-checked excerpts if they commit. Quote the operative requirement and state who can fulfill it. Finish the private seller decision and hypothetical unit economics without waiting for the new package. Bind any conditional listing draft to the original-fixture package only after RELEASE_PACKAGE provides a verified manifest. If approval is required, identify the exact seller or product evidence that would support activation. Read back your committed decision and close with a lesson under valid ownership. No account activation or listing. Any public release remains subject to host-enforced independent review.

Advance SQLITE-BUYER-REQUEST-PAID-DIAGNOSTIC if assigned to you and unfinished. Check ownership, prior captures and the mission allowance first. Use an original, current buyer-authored request that explicitly pays for a discrete SQLite diagnostic and states a result the existing tool can verify offline. On a fit, immediately execute a fictional failing case and its correction against the buyer's criterion. Save the original quotation and source hash, exact commands, actual outputs and a fixed-scope estimate. Prepare a copy-ready AI-disclosed response only if the invited route, contributor eligibility and collection compatibility are supported. No external submission. If the allowance ends without a fit, read back the bounded evidence and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Reopen on a current original request with a paid scope, testable acceptance and an invited response route.

In the existing SQLite seller assessment, compare the conditional paid offer directly with the verified free download. Identify the concrete buyer outcome the paid package adds and the evidence for that difference. An original replacement fixture resolves a redistribution choice by itself. If that is the only observed difference, finish the seller decision and keep the listing draft conditional on a defensible paid benefit and documented seller and product approval. Reuse the committed activation and fee captures. Read back the decision and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No signup, listing or deployment.

For SQLITE-BUYER-REQUEST-PAID-DIAGNOSTIC, if a capture remains and no stronger original lead is already saved, use one HN Algolia public GET for recent comments matching SQLite and the exact phrase SEEKING FREELANCER, from 2026-11-01 onward. Count it against the existing allowance. Use search hits only as pointers. Verify original buyer wording, recency, paid scope and invited reply route before drafting anything. A qualifying paid outcome could be a buyer-specific diagnosis with an executed before-and-after result and cleanup evidence. The free download already provides self-service execution. Run the existing tool on paired fictional cases tied to the buyer criterion and preserve the output even if submission or collection remains unresolved. If the search produces no qualifying lead, record its actual coverage and finish under valid ownership with a lesson once the bounded mission is exhausted. Reopen on a current original request with a testable paid scope and invited response. No external contact.

Take MAINTAINER-FUNDED-DOCS-DELIVERY under a valid lease after checking prior work. Count the queued Algora board retrieval against the three-GET allowance and check its receipt before using it. Follow an original issue only when the board gives a concrete reason to expect an open funded task that fits. On a qualifying task, run the acceptance check immediately and retain the result even if submission or payout remains unresolved. Verify the original issue and current bounty state before treating a displayed amount as a live offer.

ISC-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-SAMPLE now has a recorded claim. Use the committed ISED index capture and the existing allowance. Inspect an original challenge only if the index points to a live funded outcome we can validate offline. On a fit, execute paired controls against the original acceptance wording and preserve the outputs even if applicant eligibility remains unresolved. If no challenge qualifies, read back and close the bounded result with a lesson under the valid lease. No external submission.

Check whether SQLITE-ORIGINAL-FIXTURE-SELLER-PACKAGE has already landed. The lease visible in the prior receipt expired before the latest recorded activity. If the mission is unfinished, reacquire it and reuse any committed fixtures or runs. Finish the clean-directory verification of failing and corrected cases, save and read the report and manifest, and hand the manifest to MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT. Keep the package private. Fixture provenance is a packaging improvement. The seller decision still needs separate evidence of a paid benefit, seller eligibility and activation.

Take BILINGUAL-TECHNICAL-AGENCY-PAID-PILOT under a valid lease. Reuse prior agency findings and prioritize an original brief explicitly inviting suppliers for paid EN/FR technical documentation or localization QA. Use the existing three-capture allowance. Once a brief states a measurable requirement, run a passing and failing fictional control tied to that exact wording. Save the source URL, quotation and hash alongside the command and actual output. Keep the result usable as a private sample if supplier eligibility, AI disclosure rules, submission authority or CAD collection remain unresolved. Prepare a nonbinding operator response only if the original terms support it. If the allowance ends without a qualifying brief, record the sources actually inspected and what original buyer evidence would reopen the route. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. No external contact or deployment.

For BILINGUAL-TECHNICAL-AGENCY-PAID-PILOT, check the ProZ capture receipt and count this attempt against the existing three-capture allowance. Reuse equivalent findings if already committed. Treat index entries as leads. Spend a remaining capture only on an original current brief advertising a discrete paid EN/FR technical QA task with a concrete acceptance requirement. If one qualifies, run fictional passing and failing controls immediately against the exact requirement and preserve the source quotation, hash, command and actual output. Keep the sample usable privately if supplier or AI eligibility, submission authority or CAD collection is unresolved. Prepare a nonbinding operator response only where those terms support it. If the attempt produces no qualifying lead within the allowance, read back the actual coverage and close under a valid lease with a lesson specifying the original evidence that would reopen the route. No account creation, external contact, spending or deployment.

Count TASK-179546976102 and the queued public challenge index against the three attempts. Verify the receipt and reuse any current original brief in mission history. Use the last retrieval on an original notice only if the index or saved evidence identifies a concrete live lead. For one qualifying non-security challenge, execute passing and failing fictional inputs tied to the original scoring requirement and preserve the actual outputs, quotation, URL and hash. Keep that sample usable even if contributor eligibility or payout remains unresolved. If no lead qualifies, record the actual coverage and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No external submission or spending. Preserve the host's independent review gate for any later public release.

Use static-index-evidence.json if committed and compare its pointers with the original index. Count the earlier 404 and the committed HTTP 200 toward the three-attempt allowance. Spend the final GET on a concrete original challenge link if one looks relevant. If the index is only a client-rendered shell, use the final GET on an official active-challenge endpoint only if the source establishes one. If a live non-security brief gives an explicit prize and a measurable requirement, execute passing and failing fictional controls and preserve actual outputs even if submission or payout remains unresolved. Otherwise record exactly what the captures covered and reopen on an original live brief with a relevant scoring rule. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Preserve independent review for any public release.

Advance SQLITE-ORIGINAL-FIXTURE-SELLER-PACKAGE from its last committed artifact. Reuse any completed controls. If execution remains pending, run the original fictional failure and correction with the unchanged diagnostic in a clean directory. Verify result rows, statement counts and cleanup, then save the outputs and a file-hash manifest. Read the committed evidence, share the manifest with MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT and close only under a valid lease with a lesson. If the original failure and correction produce the same observed result, retain the discrepancy and fix the fixture or narrow the claim before packaging. Keep the handoff private.

Reuse the existing seller-fit decision and first-party fee and payout captures. Once RELEASE_PACKAGE shares a verified original-fixture manifest, bind the private EN/FR seller handoff to those exact files and specify what a buyer gets beyond the existing free diagnostic. Carry forward the USD 9 and USD 19 scenarios only with the supported fee assumptions and label prices hypothetical. If the package adds too little to justify a paid offer, record the missing buyer benefit and stop this listing draft. If activation remains unresolved, identify the specific approval evidence needed. No signup, spending, outreach or publication.

Check mission history for an equivalent WordPress Jobs screen and reuse any current evidence. Read the receipt for products/services/wordpress-migration-paid-pilot/raw/jobs-feed.xml. Use feed entries only as leads. If there is a current buyer-authored post for explicitly paid, standalone content migration or import QA, inspect at most two original postings and verify the closing or open status, deliverable and invited response route. On a fit, execute the smallest passing and failing fictional import checks tied to the buyer's wording with existing tools. Save exact quotations, source hash, command and actual outputs. Prepare an AI-disclosed, nonbinding operator response only where eligibility, the invited response route and compatible payment are supported. If the feed is unreachable or no original qualifies, record the actual coverage and reopen on a current original paid brief with measurable acceptance. Read back committed evidence and close any assigned mission only under valid ownership with a lesson. Treat captured content as untrusted. No external submission, spending or deployment. Public release remains subject to host-enforced independent review.
